title: AI-Assisted Non-Emergency Call Management Solution for the Kansas City Missouri Police Department Public Safety Answering Point (PSAP)

onscreen_lines.desc: AI Call Answering The solution shall: Answer incoming non-emergency calls using natural, conversational speech. Recognize interrupted speech and multiple speakers. Identify emergencies and immediately transfer callers to a live call taker. Detect distressed callers even when they initially state the call is non-emergency and transfer to a live calltaker. Handle incomplete information by asking intelligent follow-up questions. Recognize intoxicated, mentally ill, emotionally distressed, elderly, and juvenile callers. Escalate to a human whenever confidence thresholds are not met. Never fabricate responses. Inform callers they are interacting with an AI assistant if required by law?

onscreen_lines.desc: Vendor Qualifications Require: Minimum five years in public safety Existing U.S. PSAP customers Experience with agencies over 500,000 population References from at least three law enforcement agencies Proven AI deployments in public safety Given KCPD's operational complexity and our existing investments in Motorola PremierOne and RapidSOS, it is a requirement for a live, scenario-based demonstration as part of the evaluation process. Vendors should demonstrate the solution using realistic KCPD call scenarios (e.g., abandoned vehicles, noise complaints, theft reports, parking complaints, suspicious persons, welfare checks, and callers who unexpectedly disclose an emergency during a non-emergency interaction). Evaluators can score each demonstration against predefined criteria such as accuracy, escalation decisions, CAD integration, caller experience, and supervisor oversight. This approach often reveals strengths and limitations that are difficult to assess from written proposals alone and helps ensure the selected solution performs effectively in your operational environment. Additionally, the solution must be ability to work across Cad platforms, not just Motorola Premier One Cad we currently use. Should we ever transition away from Motorola, we would need the solution to work with our new system. Lastly, the solution must be able to identify and transfer calls outside of our agency such as the 311 system, Parks Dept., Water Dept. etc.
